design.name: Home Sweet Home
design.opening: Turn the key to your new home
design.description: An architectural sketch becomes a home, carved doors open and guests light a welcoming lamp.
design.interaction: Include the blessing lamp and doorbell

html:
Dear Your Family,

A new home, a new beginning

and the first key is for you

Best with sound on

a fresh kolam for you

come in here!

ProjectOur new homeOwnersHari & KavyaSheet 01Front elevationDate10 · 02 · 2027

Dear Your Family,

You're invited to the housewarming of

Hari & Kavya

and little Tara

WEDNESDAY · 10 FEBRUARY 2027

SCROLL

Welcome

Please come in, the door is open for you

The first step in

With the kalasam and the lamp, we step into our new home together.

The milk boils over

May our home always overflow with love, health and plenty.

With the blessings of our elders

Hari & Kavya Krishnan

and little Tara

warmly invite you and your family to bless our new home

Wednesday · 10 February 2027

Morning

Ganapathi puja & milk boiling

6:30 AM

The most auspicious moment of the day. Please come a little early.

Add to calendar

Afternoon

Lunch with us

12:00 noon

A traditional lunch, served on banana leaf.

Add to calendar

Our new address

No. 14, Sunrise Avenue

Pallikaranai, Chennai

Look for the banana trees and marigolds at our gate!

Directions
Come early

The puja begins at 6:30 AM, the auspicious hour.

Footwear

Please leave your footwear at the rack by the gate.

Parking

Street parking along Sunrise Avenue.

Gifts

Your blessings are our gift.

Counting down to our first morning

88DAYS
06HOURS
40MINUTES
05SECONDS

Before you come

Light a lamp for our home

Tap the lamp to light it, and send us your blessing.

Send your blessing on WhatsApp

RSVP

Will you visit us?

Kindly reply by 3 February 2027.

Will you come?
You'll join us for

2

Please add your name so the family knows who replied.

Your reply goes directly to the hosts through WhatsApp.

Our new home

From our very first sunrise here…

to every evening after, our door is always open for you.

With love

Hari, Kavya & Tara
